# scripts/automation/Invoke-AvdSandboxDeadline.ps1

<!-- Generated by scripts/Update-BrainDocs.ps1 from the code. Do not edit; edit the code and regenerate. -->

The deadline teardown for a sandbox batch group (decision 0021): runs once, at the group's deadline, whether or not anyone is there.
